Shareholder Rothschild Investment Corp Has Raised Albemarle Corp Com (ALB) Holding
July 23, 2018 - By Patrick Harkless
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.99 in Q1 2018. Its down 0.02, from 1.01 in 2017Q4. It is negative, as 82 investors sold ALB shares while 156 reduced holdings. 72 funds opened positions while 163 raised stakes. 93.28 million shares or 0.45% more from 92.86 million shares in 2017Q4 were reported. Amalgamated Bank & Trust invested in 14,166 shares or 0.03% of the stock.
Rothschild Investment Corp increased its stake in Albemarle Corp Com (ALB) by 753.11% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rothschild Investment Corp bought 60,136 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.88% with the market. The institutional investor held 68,121 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.32M, up from 7,985 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rothschild Investment Corp who had been investing in Albemarle Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $10.40 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.40% or $2.31 during the last trading session, reaching $93.9. About shares traded. Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) has declined 15.78% since July 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.35% the S&P500.
Rothschild Investment Corp, which manages about $1.10 billion and $781.80M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Halliburton Company (NYSE:HAL) by 97,544 shares to 31,986 shares, valued at $1.50M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Visa Inc Com Cl A (NYSE:V) by 39,362 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 50,630 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Computer Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
